 Criminal Appeal No. 466 of 2006
 Kamal Pusla Bhil

 The State Of M.P.
 Appearance:
 Ms. Purnima Kanungo - Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri Rajesh Joshi G.A appearing on behalf of State.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 10.01.2005 in Sessions Case No.77/05 by the Third Additional Session Judge, (Fast Track), Badwani whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Section 506, 376/511 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 1 year R.I , 10 years R.I and fine of Rs.250/-, with default stipulation.

entities.text: Third Additional Session Judge, (Fast Track), Badwani
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. This appeal arises out of the incident dated 26.06.2005 in which accused had committed Rape with prosecutrix and regarding which a Crime No.235/2005 was registered at Police Station Badwani, Badwani.

3. The PUD No.1081/Warrant/2025 dated 29.06.2025 of Superintendent, Central Jail - Badwani mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 10.12.2010 after completing the sentence and depositing the fine amount.

Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
